snippet.title: Zozo and the Lost Dreams - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4604520/Zozo_and_the_Lost_Dreams_Demo/

Meet Zozo, a 13-year-old boy who dreams of becoming a superhero—literally and figuratively. With the help of his mad scientist neighbor, Professor Aisha, Zozo is able to enter his dreams and live out his fantasy of becoming a superhero. However, a strange incident prevents him from waking up! Zozo must now go on an adventure to find his way back home.

Zozo and The Lost Dreams is a 2D Metroidvania platformer inspired by classic Saturday-morning cartoons.

Developer: Red Dunes Games, Agate
X: https://x.com/zozolostdreams
